sections.name: default
sections.sig:
< default (max exfiltration max exfiltration )               ; Default Hansen value.
                 (temperature change rate 0.5 [h−1 ])
                 (EpFactor 0.6 [])
                 (EpFactor SWE EpFactor SWE )                  ; Has default value.
                 (albedo dry 0.15 [])
                 (albedo wet 0.08 [])
                 (pond section pond section ...)
                 (DetentionCapacity 1000 [mm])
                 (ReservoirConstant 1 [h−1 ])
                 (LocalDetentionCapacity 10 [mm])
                 (z mixing 0.1 [cm])
                 (R mixing 1e+09 [h/mm]) >

attrs.name: max exfiltration
attrs.doc: Soil limited exfiltration.

attrs.name: temperature change rate
attrs.doc:
Relative change of surface temperature. If you set this to a negative value,
     surface temperature will reflect temperature of incomming water or ponded
     water, if any, snow, if any, or air temperature. Set this parameter to a positive
     value to dampen changes. Especially useful if you feed the model with daily
     weather data and average temperature.

attrs.name: EpFactor
attrs.doc:
Value description: See figure 4 in the cited paper.
     The autumn value can be lower, due to muching. With a crop factor of 1.2 a
     combined Kc of 1.15 is reached at LAI=5. See also [Kjaersgaard et al., 2008]
     Convertion of reference evapotranspiration to potential evaporation for bare
     soil.

attrs.name: EpFactor SWE
attrs.doc: Effect of soil water on EpFactor.

attrs.name: albedo dry
attrs.doc: Albedo of dry soil (pF >= 3)

attrs.name: albedo wet
attrs.doc: Albedo of wet soil (pf <= 1.7)

attrs.name: pond section
attrs.doc:
Amount of ponding on each section of the surface. By default, there will be
        no ponding. In an 1D simulation, there will only be one section. In general,
        there will be a section for each numeric cell in the soil matrix with an edge
        towards the surface.

attrs.name: DetentionCapacity
attrs.doc:
Amount of ponding the surface can retain. If ponding in any part of the
        surface is above this, exceed will runoff.

attrs.name: ReservoirConstant
attrs.doc: Fraction of ponding above DetentionCapacity that runoffs each hour.

attrs.name: LocalDetentionCapacity
attrs.doc:
Amount of ponding the surface can retain locally. If ponding in any part of
        the surface is above this, exceed will be distributed to the rest of the surface.

attrs.name: z mixing
attrs.doc:
Depth of mixing layer in the top of the soil. The mixing layer affect exchange
        between soil coloids, soil water and the surface, especially in connection with
        intense rainfall.

attrs.name: R mixing
attrs.doc: Resistance to mixing inorganic compounds between soil and ponding.

attrs.name: T
attrs.doc: Temperature of water or air directly above the surface.

attrs.name: pond
attrs.doc: Amount of ponding on the surface. Negative numbers indicate soil exfiltration.

attrs.name: EvapSoilSurface
attrs.doc: Water evaporated from the surface, including the pond and exfiltration.

attrs.name: Eps
attrs.doc: Potential evaporation from the surface.

attrs.name: runoff
attrs.doc: Amount of water runoff from ponding this hour.

attrs.name: ME
attrs.doc: Soil limit on exfiltration rate.

sections.text:
Keep track of soil surface.
   Used by column default Surface (see 26.1, page 153) .
  < default (max exfiltration max exfiltration )               ; Default Hansen value.
                 (temperature change rate 0.5 [h−1 ])
                 (EpFactor 0.6 [])
                 (EpFactor SWE EpFactor SWE )                  ; Has default value.
                 (albedo dry 0.15 [])
                 (albedo wet 0.08 [])
                 (pond section pond section ...)
                 (DetentionCapacity 1000 [mm])
                 (ReservoirConstant 1 [h−1 ])
                 (LocalDetentionCapacity 10 [mm])
                 (z mixing 0.1 [cm])
                 (R mixing 1e+09 [h/mm]) >

    max exfiltration: max exfiltration component (see chapter 55)
     Component (default ‘Hansen’)
     Soil limited exfiltration.

    temperature change rate: number [h−1 ]
     Parameter (default 0.5)
     Relative change of surface temperature. If you set this to a negative value,
     surface temperature will reflect temperature of incomming water or ponded
     water, if any, snow, if any, or air temperature. Set this parameter to a positive
     value to dampen changes. Especially useful if you feed the model with daily
     weather data and average temperature.

    EpFactor : number (dimensionless)
     Parameter (default 0.6)
     Value description: See figure 4 in the cited paper.
     The autumn value can be lower, due to muching. With a crop factor of 1.2 a
     combined Kc of 1.15 is reached at LAI=5. See also [Kjaersgaard et al., 2008]
     Convertion of reference evapotranspiration to potential evaporation for bare
     soil.

       EpFactor SWE : plf [pF → <none>]
        Parameter (has default const value 1 [])
        Effect of soil water on EpFactor.
       albedo dry: number (dimensionless)
        Parameter (default 0.15)
        Albedo of dry soil (pF >= 3)
       albedo wet: number (dimensionless)
        Parameter (default 0.08)
        Albedo of wet soil (pf <= 1.7)
       pond section: number [mm] sequence
        Optional state variable
        Amount of ponding on each section of the surface. By default, there will be
        no ponding. In an 1D simulation, there will only be one section. In general,
        there will be a section for each numeric cell in the soil matrix with an edge
        towards the surface.
       DetentionCapacity: number [mm]
        State variable (default 1000)
        Amount of ponding the surface can retain. If ponding in any part of the
        surface is above this, exceed will runoff.
       ReservoirConstant: number [h−1 ]
        Parameter (default 1)
        Fraction of ponding above DetentionCapacity that runoffs each hour.
       LocalDetentionCapacity: number [mm]
        State variable (default 10)
        Amount of ponding the surface can retain locally. If ponding in any part of
        the surface is above this, exceed will be distributed to the rest of the surface.
       z mixing: number [cm]
        Parameter (default 0.1)
        Depth of mixing layer in the top of the soil. The mixing layer affect exchange
        between soil coloids, soil water and the surface, especially in connection with
        intense rainfall.
       R mixing: number [h/mm]
        Parameter (default 1e+09)
        Resistance to mixing inorganic compounds between soil and ponding.

Log Variables
       T : number [dg C]
        Temperature of water or air directly above the surface.
       pond : number [mm]
        Amount of ponding on the surface. Negative numbers indicate soil exfiltration.
       EvapSoilSurface: number [mm/h]
        Water evaporated from the surface, including the pond and exfiltration.
       Eps: number [mm/h]
        Potential evaporation from the surface.
       runoff : number [mm/h]
        Amount of water runoff from ponding this hour.

    ME : number [mm/h]
     Soil limit on exfiltration rate.
